sloka: सैन्यैः परिवृताः सर्वे वानराणाम् महौजसाम् ।उपायैर् अभिगच्चामो यथा नद नदी पतिम् ॥६-१९-२९॥।।
transliteration: sainyaiḥ parivṛtāḥ sarve vānarāṇām mahaujasām ।upāyair abhigaccāmo yathā nada nadī patim ॥6-19-29॥।।

translations.english: "One who fails to protect a refugee who seeks protection from him is ruined in the eyes of the refugee and he takes away all the merit."
